sentences.text: Faye Denise Resnick -LRB- born July 3 , 1957 -RRB- is an American television personality , author , and interior designer .

She is best known for her involvement in the O. J. Simpson murder trial and for her appearance on the reality television series The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills .	The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills	The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills	O. J. Simpson murder trial	O. J. Simpson murder case
